title: Itô perspective on variance renormalisation
summary: We show that the Itô solutions of the nonlinear stochastic heat equation $$ \partial_t u^\varepsilon- Δu^\varepsilon =\varepsilon^{3/4} g (u^\varepsilon) \nabla ξ_\varepsilon, $$ where $ ξ_\varepsilon$ denotes the mollification in space at scale $\varepsilon>0$ of a space-time white noise $ξ$, converge in law, as $\varepsilon\to 0$, to the solution of the stochastic heat equation with right-hand side $cg'g(u)ξ$ with a constant $c>0$. Since the noise $\nablaξ$ is supercritical, the small prefactor is not unexpected to obtain a limit, but the exponent $3/4$ is not predicted by naive scaling…
